rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or thing that creates something.

example.english: The creator of this program was really dedicated.
example.traditional: 呢個程式嘅創造者真係好有心機。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 ge3 cong3 zou6 ze2 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 sam1 gei1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the deity believed to have created the world.

example.english: Many people believe the creator created this world.
example.traditional: 好多人相信造物主創造咗呢個世界。
example.jyutping: hou2 do1 jan4 soeng1 seon3 zou6 mat6 zyu2 cong3 zou6 zo2 ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3

rows.note: Use this in sports for a player who organizes attacks and creates scoring opportunities.

example.english: They are the team's creator, always making scoring chances for their teammates.
example.traditional: 佢係球隊嘅組織者，成日幫隊友製造入波機會。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 kau4 deoi6 ge3 zou2 zik1 ze2 seng4 jat6 bong1 deoi6 jau5 zai3 zou6 jap6 bo1 gei1 wui6
